categoryName: Festival, gifting & occasion — rakhi, diwali, gift wrap, greeting cards, party & decor, candles, birthday supplies, cake accessories

skuLines.line: Birthday cake candles — plain stick & spiral
skuLines.examples: Party Propz metallic spiral stick candles (6-10 pc), Chocozone rainbow stick candles, generic white/coloured 24-pc birthday candles
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round, tracks the academic calendar; near-zero during school vacation
skuLines.notes: With ~5,000 residents there are ~13-14 birthdays a day — this is the single highest-frequency line in the whole category. Wax softens/blooms above 30°C but the hill climate is friendly; keep off damp floors during monsoon.

skuLines.line: Number candles 0-9 and big 'Happy Birthday' letter candles
skuLines.examples: Party Propz gold number candle, Cakezone glitter number candle, Azebon numeral candle
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; milestone spikes (18th, 21st, staff 40th/50th)
skuLines.notes: Stock 0-9 in equal depth plus doubles of 1 and 2 (ages 1, 2, 10-19, 21). Slow-moving as singles, so buy the 0-9 board, not by digit.

skuLines.line: Sparkler / fountain 'fire' candles
skuLines.examples: Party Propz Sparkle cake candle, Flyloons cold-fire candle, generic 12 cm cake sparkler
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round
skuLines.notes: Open flame with sparks inside a residential hostel — get the school warden's written OK before stocking, or restrict sale to staff quarters and the canteens. Store away from any pyro/flammables; not a firework legally, but treat it as one operationally.

skuLines.line: Cake toppers — 'Happy Birthday', theme cutouts, acrylic
skuLines.examples: Party Propz Happy Birthday golden topper (₹139), Picfest theme topper, generic acrylic/glitter card topper
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round
skuLines.notes: Highest-margin line in the category and near-zero spoilage — thin card/acrylic, stores flat. Ideal impulse placement at the cake pre-order desk.

skuLines.line: Cake boards, cake boxes and cake bases
skuLines.examples: generic 8"/10"/12" round silver cake board, corrugated cake box with window, half-kg / 1-kg box
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round
skuLines.notes: Consumed by ARY's own canteens/bakery as well as sold. Corrugated board absorbs monsoon damp and collapses — poly-wrap the bundles and keep on a pallet, and buy the December-March requirement dry rather than in July-September.

skuLines.line: Edible cake decoration — sprinkles, confetti, silver balls, gems, choco chips
skuLines.examples: BakeShake sprinkles, Weikfield/Bush cake gems, generic silver balls & vermicelli, Tulsi sugar confetti
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round
skuLines.notes: FSSAI-labelled food item — check batch/expiry, typically 9-12 month shelf life. Sugar sprinkles cake up solid in high humidity; buy small packs, not bulk jars, at this location.

skuLines.line: Non-dairy whipping cream, piping bags & nozzles, cake decorating tools
skuLines.examples: Rich's Whip Topping, Tropolite whipping cream, generic 12" piping bags + steel nozzle set, turntable, palette knife
skuLines.packSizes: 500 ml / 1 L cream packs; 10-50 pc bag packs; 6-12 pc nozzle sets
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round
skuLines.notes: COLD CHAIN: whipping cream is frozen/chilled (-18°C to 4°C) and will not survive a 30-50 km unrefrigerated hill run in summer — either move it on the same cold vehicle as dairy or skip the cream and stock only the tools. Tools themselves are shelf-stable and worth carrying regardless.

skuLines.line: Party wearables — caps, birthday sash, crown, badges, masks, wigs
skuLines.examples: Party Propz birthday cap set, 'Birthday Girl' sash, Flyloons foil crown, themed eye masks
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round
skuLines.notes: Lightweight, non-perishable, high margin — perfect hill-freight economics. Keep the ₹30-₹60 single cap for hostel-room birthdays and the ₹199+ kit for staff-family parties.

skuLines.line: Party poppers, blowouts, horns, confetti, snow spray
skuLines.examples: generic ribbon party popper, Party Propz confetti cannon, paper blowout whistles, foam/snow spray can
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; spikes at New Year and farewell/annual day
skuLines.notes: Snow/foam spray is a pressurised aerosol — road-transport restriction on some carriers and it must not be stored near heat. Confetti creates a housekeeping load; hostels sometimes ban it, so check before depth-buying.

skuLines.line: Foil balloons — numbers, letters, hearts, stars, character
skuLines.examples: Party Propz 18" number foil, HAPPY BIRTHDAY letter foil set, Lala Balloon heart foil, character foils
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round
skuLines.notes: The classic party-supplies margin example: buy ~₹15, sell ~₹50. Store flat and deflated — indefinite shelf life, ideal for a location that gets one truck a month. Foil is metallised: never let it near overhead electrical lines during setup.

skuLines.line: Latex balloons — plain bulk, pastel/macaron, metallic/chrome
skuLines.examples: Party Propz multicolour metallic 50-pc, pastel macaron 100-pc, chrome gold/silver/rose-gold 25-pc
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; heaviest Oct-Feb (event season) and around annual day
skuLines.notes: Latex oxidises and perishes — 6-12 months usable, faster in damp heat, and cold makes it brittle at inflation time. Don't over-order; hold ~2 months' cover. Pastel/macaron and chrome are what 2026 buyers actually ask for; plain multicolour is the value tier.

skuLines.line: Balloon accessories — hand pump, arch tape, glue dots, weights, ribbon
skuLines.examples: generic manual double-action balloon pump, 5 m balloon decorating strip, 100-dot glue roll, balloon curling ribbon
skuLines.packSizes: 1 pc pump; 5 m/10 m tape; 100-dot rolls
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round
skuLines.notes: The pump is the enabler SKU — without it a 100-balloon pack is unusable and gets returned. No helium: cylinders are a compressed-gas transport and storage problem on hill roads, so sell air-fill decor and arch tape instead.

skuLines.line: Birthday banners, buntings and backdrops
skuLines.examples: Party Propz HAPPY BIRTHDAY foil banner, alphabet card bunting, black/gold fringe curtain, printed cloth backdrop
skuLines.packSizes: 1 banner; 3 m-5 m bunting; 1 m x 2 m backdrop; fringe curtain 1 m x 2 m
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; also annual day / farewell
skuLines.notes: Paper/card banners warp and mottle in monsoon damp — prefer foil and cloth for this location; keep card banners sleeved. Reusable cloth backdrops are also a rental opportunity for the school's own events.

skuLines.line: Ready-made birthday decoration kit (30-60 pcs)
skuLines.examples: Party Propz 55-pc kit (₹359), Bezente 60-pc kit, Lala Balloon black-golden kit (₹299), SpecialYou kit (₹597)
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round
skuLines.notes: The fastest-growing shape in 2026 — one SKU replaces a decorator and does the whole ₹300-₹600 basket in a single scan. For a captive campus with no party shop within 30-50 km, this is the flagship line. Carry 3-4 themes (pastel, blue, pink, black-gold) rather than 12.

skuLines.line: Themed party tableware — printed plates, cups, napkins, table cover, straws
skuLines.examples: generic unicorn/space/superhero paper plate sets, printed paper cups, themed napkins, plastic table cover, paper straws
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round
skuLines.notes: Themes must MATCH the decoration kit themes you carry — coordinated sets are what parents buy in 2026, mismatched singles die on the shelf. Paper stock is the most damp-sensitive item here; sleeve and rotate.

skuLines.line: Plain disposable tableware for functions — paper/areca plates, cups, spoons
skuLines.examples: DMart disposable paper plates 17 cm / 10", areca leaf plates, 200 ml paper cups, plastic spoons
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; heavy at langar/Gurpurab, annual day, staff functions
skuLines.notes: Bulky, low-value freight — order in full-carton multiples on the same truck as the festival decor. Thermocol is being phased out on plastic-waste rules and reads badly at an eco-conscious institution; lead with paper and areca leaf.

skuLines.line: Return gifts — themed, stationery combos and small toys
skuLines.examples: themed goodie-bag sets, pencil-box + stationery combos, keychain/eraser sets, small plush or puzzle toys
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; spikes on parents' visiting days
skuLines.notes: 2026 shift: theme-coordinated return gifts have replaced random loose toys. Toys need BIS/ISI (Quality Control Order) marking and an age warning — buy from a compliant supplier, not a loose-goods wholesaler. Pre-pack in 10s so a parent buys one bag, not ten scans.

skuLines.line: Gift wrapping paper — printed sheets and plain kraft
skuLines.examples: Archies Lining / Little Joy wrap sheet (₹89-₹125), PaperPep heart-print sheet, plain brown kraft sheet, Archies 50-sheet pack
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; hard spikes Rakhi (Aug), Diwali/Bandi Chhor (Oct-Nov), New Year, wedding season (Nov-Feb)
skuLines.notes: Paper + heavy monsoon is the core hill problem: sheets cockle, ink offsets, and a warped sheet is unsellable. Store flat in poly sleeves in a sealed cupboard, never rolled on the floor; hold small quantities and reorder rather than one big monsoon buy.

skuLines.line: Gift wrap rolls, metallic/foil wrap and cellophane
skuLines.examples: generic 5 m gift wrap roll, metallic foil wrap, transparent cellophane roll, hamper net cloth
skuLines.packSizes: 5 m, 10 m rolls; 1 m x 5 m cellophane
skuLines.seasonality: Festival + wedding season
skuLines.notes: Cellophane and net are what make a self-assembled hamper look finished — pair them on the same shelf as empty gift boxes. Rolls travel better than sheets on a hill road (no crease damage).

skuLines.line: Gift bags — paper, non-woven and jute carry bags
skuLines.examples: Archies Print Pack paper gift bag S/M/L, non-woven D-cut bag, printed jute gift bag, birthday goodie bag
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; spikes at every festival
skuLines.notes: Often replaces wrapping entirely for a hostel gift — stock more depth in M and L than in S. Jute/kraft is the sustainable-gifting pull in 2026 and suits a Trust-run institution's optics.

skuLines.line: Gift boxes, hamper baskets and trays (empty, for self-assembly)
skuLines.examples: rigid magnetic gift box, corrugated hamper box, cane/bamboo hamper basket, decorative metal tray, empty mithai/dry-fruit box
skuLines.seasonality: Diwali/Bandi Chhor (Oct-Nov), wedding season, Rakhi
skuLines.notes: Build-your-own-hamper is a real 2026 behaviour: empty box + filler + cellophane + ribbon. Bulky and crushable — nest sizes inside each other for the truck run and never stack anything on them in the warehouse.

skuLines.line: Ribbons, bows, laces and decorative twine
skuLines.examples: Urban Fest organza ribbon roll (2 pc ₹84-₹149), satin ribbon roll, pre-made stick-on bows, raffia/jute twine, curling ribbon
skuLines.packSizes: 5 m, 10 m, 18 m rolls; 6-12 pc bow packs
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round
skuLines.notes: Tiny cube, long shelf life, no spoilage — one of the best margin-per-cubic-foot lines you can put on a hill truck. Also feeds the gift-wrap counter's own consumption.

skuLines.line: Gift tags, name labels and gift-wrap counter consumables
skuLines.examples: printed 'To/From' gift tags, kraft hang tags, double-sided tape, glue stick, cello tape + dispenser
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round
skuLines.notes: Low value on its own; its job is to make a paid gift-wrapping counter possible and to lift the wrap basket by ₹20-₹40. Keep at the counter, not on a gondola.

skuLines.line: Greeting cards — birthday (kids and adult tiers)
skuLines.examples: Archies birthday card, Hallmark India birthday card, generic ₹10-₹20 value card, ITC/local kids' card
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round, tied to the residential calendar
skuLines.notes: Printed cards are declining globally (-1.7% CAGR to 2026) as e-cards take over, BUT a residential school with no phones for younger students is exactly the niche where the paper card survives — 5,000 co-resident people and ~14 birthdays a day. Damp is the killer: sleeve every card, keep the rack off an outside wall, and buy the ₹10-₹20 tier deepest since the average ARY bill is ₹208.

skuLines.line: Greeting cards — occasion range (thank you, congratulations, farewell, get well, wedding, anniversary, new baby)
skuLines.examples: Archies occasion range, Hallmark 'Congratulations'/'Thank You', local wedding & anniversary cards
skuLines.seasonality: Farewell/convocation Feb-Apr; weddings Nov-Feb; babies year-round
skuLines.notes: Married-staff families and the university cohort drive this. Keep the range narrow and the depth shallow — occasion cards are the slowest-turning cards and the most damp-exposed.

skuLines.line: Greeting cards — Teachers' Day, Children's Day and school-occasion cards
skuLines.examples: Archies Teachers' Day card, 'Best Teacher' card, thank-you card multipacks
skuLines.seasonality: Teachers' Day 5 Sep (huge single-day spike), Children's Day 14 Nov
skuLines.notes: In a residential school this is a one-week, hundreds-of-units event: every class buys a card for every teacher. Get the buy in by mid-August and offer a class-pack price — otherwise the whole spike leaks to a town trip. Sell it alongside pens, wrap and small mugs as a bundle.

skuLines.line: Festival greeting cards — Gurpurab, Diwali/Bandi Chhor, Baisakhi, New Year
skuLines.examples: Gurpurab / Guru Nanak Jayanti cards, 'Happy Bandi Chhor Divas' cards, Baisakhi cards, New Year cards, corporate-style Trust cards
skuLines.seasonality: Guru Nanak Jayanti 24 Nov 2026; Bandi Chhor Divas 8 Nov 2026; Baisakhi 13-14 Apr; Guru Gobind Singh Jayanti Jan; New Year Dec-Jan
skuLines.notes: Sikh-institution specific and almost certainly NOT what a generic distributor's festive card assortment carries — source Gurpurab and Baisakhi designs deliberately (Punjab/Amritsar suppliers) rather than accepting a Diwali-only pack. The Trust itself is a bulk buyer for outbound greetings.

skuLines.line: Premium cards — handmade, musical, 3D pop-up, big-size
skuLines.examples: Archies big-size card, musical greeting card, 3D pop-up card, Itsy Bitsy handmade card
skuLines.seasonality: Farewell, milestone birthdays, weddings
skuLines.notes: Carries the premium end of the ₹208-average basket and gives the rack a price anchor. Musical cards contain a button cell — dead batteries after a year on shelf, so buy 6-12 pieces, not a box.

skuLines.line: Shagun / money envelopes (lifafa) and gift envelopes
skuLines.examples: printed shagun lifafa, Archies gifting envelopes, velvet/embossed money envelope, Rakhi posting envelope
skuLines.seasonality: Wedding season Nov-Feb; Diwali/Bandi Chhor; Rakhi; Lohri (13 Jan) and childbirth/cradle occasions
skuLines.notes: Cash gifting is the default in this demographic and the envelope is a ₹20-₹40 impulse buy with no expiry and no spoilage. Also the SKU that makes the Rakhi posting desk work in August.

skuLines.line: Autograph books, slam books, farewell scrapbooks and signing frames
skuLines.examples: generic slam book, autograph book, 'Farewell' memory book, signature photo frame/mount
skuLines.seasonality: Farewell and convocation, Feb-Apr; end of academic session
skuLines.notes: A pure residential-campus line: outgoing Class 12 and final-year Eternal University batches buy in a two-to-three week window every year. Miss the window and it sits for twelve months; buy to the batch size, which the school can tell you exactly.

skuLines.line: Card-making & craft supplies — glitter, coloured card, quilling, foam sheets, sequins
skuLines.examples: glitter card sheets, quilling strips, glitter/gel pens, sequins & beads, foam sheets, craft punch & fancy scissors, craft glue
skuLines.packSizes: 10, 20 sheet packs; 50-100 g bead/sequin packs; single tools
skuLines.seasonality: Teachers' Day, Children's Day, annual day, festival card-making activities; year-round base
skuLines.notes: At a residential school the handmade card is a school ACTIVITY, not a hobby — this line often outsells printed cards and is the one place the global card decline reverses. Coordinate with the school's art department on activity dates so stock lands before, not after.

skuLines.line: Rakhi — kids cartoon and superhero
skuLines.examples: Motu Patlu / Doraemon / Chhota Bheem rakhi, Spider-Man / Iron Man / Avengers rakhi, light-up kids rakhi
skuLines.seasonality: Raksha Bandhan — 28 Aug 2026; selling window roughly 20 Jul-28 Aug
skuLines.notes: Unbranded, no printed MRP, so it is the highest-margin seasonal line in the category — and the biggest markdown risk, because on 29 August it is worth near zero. Buy tight, reorder mid-window if it moves, and plan the whole Rakhi buy as a single consolidated hill delivery by mid-July.

skuLines.line: Rakhi — traditional thread, mauli, rudraksha, evil-eye, Ganesha
skuLines.examples: mauli/kalava thread rakhi, rudraksha rakhi, evil-eye (nazar) rakhi, zardozi & stone designer rakhi
skuLines.seasonality: Raksha Bandhan, 28 Aug 2026
skuLines.notes: Same markdown cliff as above. Note the institutional context — a Sikh campus will lean toward plain thread/mauli and simple designer rakhi over overtly Hindu-deity motifs; sell both but weight the assortment to plain and designer.

skuLines.line: Rakhi — bhaiya-bhabhi sets, lumba and silver-plated (premium)
skuLines.examples: IGP-style bhaiya-bhabhi kundan set, lumba (bangle) rakhi, silver / silver-plated rakhi, pearl rakhi
skuLines.seasonality: Raksha Bandhan, 28 Aug 2026
skuLines.notes: Married staff families are the buyer. This is the price-anchor tier — a handful of ₹500-₹999 sets makes the ₹49 rakhi look cheap. Silver-plated needs anti-tarnish poly pouches in a damp monsoon store.

skuLines.line: Rakhi thali kit and rakhi gift/posting boxes
skuLines.examples: roli-chawal-chandan-mishri thali kit, small steel/decorated puja thali, rakhi gift box, rakhi courier envelope
skuLines.seasonality: Raksha Bandhan, 28 Aug 2026
skuLines.notes: The attach SKU: a student sending a rakhi home needs the rakhi, a box, an envelope and postage in one stop. Combine with a Rakhi posting/courier desk in August and the whole basket doubles.

skuLines.line: Clay diyas, diya oil and cotton wicks (batti)
skuLines.examples: plain terracotta diya, painted/decorative diya, akhand diya, cotton batti rolls, mustard/til diya oil, ghee wick lamps
skuLines.packSizes: 12, 24, 50, 100 pc diya packs; 50-100 g batti; 200 ml-1 L oil
skuLines.seasonality: Bandi Chhor Divas 8 Nov 2026, Guru Nanak Jayanti 24 Nov 2026, Gurpurabs year-round; also weekly Gurdwara illumination
skuLines.notes: At a Sikh institution Bandi Chhor Divas and Gurpurab illumination is the whole campus lighting up — volume is institutional (the Trust, hostels, the Gurdwara), not just retail. Clay diyas are heavy, fragile and break on hill roads: order in straw-packed crates with 8-10% breakage allowance and take delivery 3 weeks early. Eco/clay is also the 2026 preference over plastic and thermocol.

skuLines.line: Plain wax candles for illumination — pillar, taper, tealight (bulk)
skuLines.examples: generic white/coloured household candle, 4-hour tealight 50-pc box, taper candles
skuLines.seasonality: Bandi Chhor/Gurpurab Nov, Christmas/New Year, Lohri 13 Jan; a steady year-round base from power cuts
skuLines.notes: Dual purpose here — festival illumination AND a hill township's power-cut backup, so it never goes fully dead. Keep below 30°C (easy at 1,700 m) and lay flat so tapers don't bow. Buy the November requirement by September on one truck.

skuLines.line: Decorative & scented candles — gel, floating, glass-jar, pillar sets
skuLines.examples: Iris/Hem scented jar candle, gel candle set, floating candles, tealight gift set, aroma candle gift box
skuLines.seasonality: Diwali/Bandi Chhor gifting Oct-Nov; New Year; year-round base
skuLines.notes: The default sub-₹500 festival gift and a genuine premium tier for a store whose average bill is ₹208. Glass jars are fragile freight — pack in cell-partitioned cartons. Scent fades on shelf; rotate within a year.

skuLines.line: LED diyas, LED tealights and battery candles
skuLines.examples: LED flameless diya 12-pc set, flickering LED tealight, battery pillar candle, button-cell packs
skuLines.seasonality: Bandi Chhor/Gurpurab Oct-Nov; year-round for hostels
skuLines.notes: THE line for a residential school — no flame means hostels and dormitories can actually use them where an oil diya is banned. Sell replacement button cells alongside; the built-in cells die in a season and a dead LED diya never gets rebought.

skuLines.line: Serial / fairy / string lights and safe extension
skuLines.examples: rice-bulb serial light, LED string light 10 m, curtain/waterfall light, star projector, ISI-marked extension board
skuLines.seasonality: Bandi Chhor Divas 8 Nov & Guru Nanak Jayanti 24 Nov 2026, Christmas/New Year, annual day, weddings
skuLines.notes: Buy BIS/ISI-marked only. Cheap serial lights in a 5,000-person residential campus with wooden and dormitory interiors are a real fire risk, and a monsoon-damp store plus non-earthed extension is a shock risk — insist on marked stock and refuse loose no-brand strings, however good the margin. Test-fire a sample from each lot on arrival.

skuLines.line: Kandeel, paper lanterns and hanging decor
skuLines.examples: akash kandil paper lantern, folding paper lantern, jhumar/latkan hanging, LED lantern
skuLines.seasonality: Bandi Chhor/Diwali Oct-Nov
skuLines.notes: Very bulky for the value — the worst freight economics in the category on a 30-50 km hill road. Buy flat-folding designs only, and treat it as a small, once-a-year, pre-consolidated order.

skuLines.line: Rangoli colours, stencils and stickers
skuLines.examples: 5-pouch rangoli colour set (₹99), 10-bottle rangoli set (₹299), rangoli stencil sheets, metallic rangoli sticker mat
skuLines.seasonality: Bandi Chhor/Diwali Oct-Nov; also annual day and welcome-gate decor for visiting dignitaries
skuLines.notes: Loose powder cakes solid in monsoon damp — buy sealed bottle sets, not open pouches, at this location. Reusable stencils and sticker mats are the 2026 growth shape and don't spoil at all.

skuLines.line: Toran, bandarwal, door hangings and artificial garlands
skuLines.examples: artificial flower bandarwal (₹399-₹599), marigold garland 5 ft (₹345-₹395), 'Shubh Labh'/lotus latkan, beaded toran
skuLines.seasonality: Bandi Chhor/Diwali Oct-Nov; weddings Nov-Feb; Baisakhi Apr
skuLines.notes: Artificial marigold garlands are also the workhorse for every campus function, Gurdwara decoration and dignitary welcome — so this is less seasonal here than in a normal town. Bulky and dust-catching; bag each piece.

skuLines.line: Sikh-specific occasion articles — Nishan Sahib/Khanda flags, stickers, Guru portraits, frames
skuLines.examples: Khanda car flag & sticker, small Nishan Sahib cloth flag, framed portraits of the Gurus, 'Waheguru'/Ik Onkar wall hanging, Khanda badge
skuLines.seasonality: Gurpurabs year-round, Baisakhi 13-14 Apr, Bandi Chhor 8 Nov, Guru Nanak Jayanti 24 Nov, Hola Mohalla, nagar kirtan processions
skuLines.notes: This is THE line a generic festive-category buyer would miss, and at The Kalgidhar Trust's own township it is a must-have, not a nicety. Handle religious articles with the respect protocols the institution expects (clean storage, never on the floor, no discount-bin display) and source from Amritsar/Punjab specialists. Portraits and framed images are given as gifts at every campus occasion.

skuLines.line: Matchboxes, long-stick lighters, camphor and agarbatti (occasion lighting)
skuLines.examples: Homelite/Cheetah matchbox, long gas lighter, refill butane, camphor tablets, Cycle/Mangaldeep agarbatti
skuLines.packSizes: 10-box match bundles; single lighter; 50-100 g camphor; 20-100 stick agarbatti
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; spikes at every Gurpurab and Bandi Chhor
skuLines.notes: Overlaps the pooja/household lane but has to sit beside the diyas — nobody buys 50 diyas and remembers the batti and the matches separately. Butane refills and camphor are flammable: separate storage from the candle and paper stock, and check what the road carrier will accept.

skuLines.line: Holi / Hola Mohalla colours — herbal gulal, pichkari, water balloons
skuLines.examples: herbal/natural gulal pouches, dry colour packs, plastic pichkari, water-balloon packs, colour-safe goggles
skuLines.packSizes: 100 g, 200 g, 400 g gulal; single pichkari; 100-pc balloon packs
skuLines.seasonality: Hola Mohalla / Holi, March — a 10-day window only
skuLines.notes: Herbal/skin-safe gulal only for a school population — synthetic colour complaints on 5,000 residents including small children is not a risk worth the margin. Ask for a skin-safe/FSSAI-grade declaration from the supplier. Ten-day sell-through, then dead: buy small.

skuLines.line: National-day items — tricolour flags, badges, ribbons, stickers
skuLines.examples: paper/plastic hand flag, khadi cotton flag, tricolour lapel badge & pin, tricolour ribbon roll & sash, flag face-stickers, tricolour balloons
skuLines.seasonality: Independence Day 15 Aug, Republic Day 26 Jan — two hard single-day spikes
skuLines.notes: A 5,000-person institution runs a full flag-hoisting parade twice a year: it is a bulk institutional order plus a retail rush, and it is 100% dead the following day. Flag Code of India applies — paper and plastic flags must not be discarded on the ground, and plastic national flags are formally discouraged, so lead with paper and cotton. Get the order landed a week early; a late truck means zero sales, not delayed sales.

skuLines.line: School / annual-day event decor — crepe paper, streamers, honeycomb, drapes, face paint
skuLines.examples: crepe paper rolls, streamer & fringe curtains, honeycomb balls, paper fans, chart & poster paper, thermocol/foam letters, face-paint kit, glitter
skuLines.packSizes: single rolls; 5, 10 pc packs; 6-12 colour paint kits
skuLines.seasonality: Annual day, sports day, cultural programmes, house competitions — clustered around the academic calendar (typically Oct-Feb here)
skuLines.notes: Institutional demand from the school and university themselves, in bursts of hundreds of units — worth agreeing an indent calendar with the activity coordinators instead of guessing. Crepe paper bleeds colour when damp; store sealed. Face paint on children needs a cosmetic-grade, dermatologically-tested declaration.

skuLines.line: Medals, trophies, certificate folders, rosettes and sashes
skuLines.examples: gold/silver/bronze medal with ribbon, acrylic & metal trophy, certificate folder, prize rosette, 'Best Student' sash
skuLines.seasonality: Sports day, annual day, prize distribution, convocation — clustered Nov-Mar
skuLines.notes: Almost entirely an institutional B2B line at this location, and the school will otherwise buy it from Chandigarh or Nahan. Custom engraving takes 2-3 weeks plus hill freight, so quote a firm lead time. Non-perishable, so unsold medals carry over to next year — low risk.

skuLines.line: Photo frames and mementos
skuLines.examples: 4x6 / 5x7 / 8x10 photo frame, collage frame, engraved acrylic or wooden memento, plaque, framed Guru portrait
skuLines.seasonality: Farewell & convocation Feb-Apr; weddings; year-round base
skuLines.notes: Glass breaks on hill roads — buy acrylic-front frames where possible and specify cell-partitioned cartons. Pairs directly with an in-store photo-printing service, which is the highest-value attach available in this whole category for a captive campus.

skuLines.line: Artificial flower bouquets and welcome bouquets
skuLines.examples: ready artificial bouquet, single-stem artificial rose, bouquet wrap paper + net + ribbon kit, welcome garland
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round — visiting dignitaries and chief guests at an institution are a constant
skuLines.notes: Fresh flowers cannot be held at 30-50 km from a market with no cold chain, so artificial is the honest answer here, plus a made-to-order wrap service using the wrap counter's own materials. An institution that hosts guests weekly makes this far less discretionary than it looks.

skuLines.line: Soft toys and plush gifting
skuLines.examples: small/medium/large teddy bear, plush character toy, heart cushion, cartoon plush keychain
skuLines.seasonality: Birthdays year-round; newborn gifting; farewell
skuLines.notes: BIS/ISI toy marking and an age label are mandatory under the Toys Quality Control Order — do not buy loose unmarked plush for a customer base that is mostly children. Very bulky for the value (worst freight ratio after lanterns): stock the ₹99-₹399 sizes deep and one or two large pieces as display anchors.

skuLines.line: Chocolate gift packs and assorted chocolate boxes
skuLines.examples: Cadbury Celebrations, Cadbury Dairy Milk Silk, Ferrero Rocher T16/T24, Sonch/Amul dark assortment
skuLines.seasonality: Rakhi Aug, Bandi Chhor/Diwali Oct-Nov, New Year, Teachers' Day; birthdays year-round
skuLines.notes: The default gift in India and the highest-turning gifting SKU — but branded FMCG margin, so it earns basket size, not gross margin. Chocolate bloom is a genuine risk on a summer hill run: it needs a below-25°C vehicle and store. Watch expiry hard on festival boxes; post-festival unsold stock has a short remaining life and no markdown market on a closed campus.

skuLines.line: Dry-fruit and mithai gift boxes
skuLines.examples: branded almond/cashew/mixed dry-fruit gift box, Happilo/Nutraj festive pack, mithai box (canteen-filled), empty printed mithai box
skuLines.seasonality: Bandi Chhor/Diwali Oct-Nov (dominant), Rakhi, weddings, Lohri
skuLines.notes: The staff and institutional festival gift, and the one place a ₹1,000+ ticket exists in this category. Dry fruit goes rancid in monsoon damp — buy nitrogen-flushed sealed packs, not loose-filled boxes, and stage the buy for late September so it does not sit through the wet months. Also stock the EMPTY box so people can fill from ARY's own dry-fruit counter.

skuLines.line: Gifting utility items — mugs, bottles, keychains, pen sets, diaries
skuLines.examples: printed ceramic mug, magic/photo mug, steel gifting bottle, branded pen set (Cello/Reynolds gift pack), planner diary, keychain
skuLines.packSizes: single; 2-pc mug sets; boxed pen sets
skuLines.seasonality: Teachers' Day 5 Sep, farewell Feb-Apr, birthdays year-round, New Year (diaries) Dec-Jan
skuLines.notes: The sweet spot for a student gifting a teacher or a friend at ₹150-₹300, right at this store's basket size. Ceramic mugs break in transit — cell cartons and a 5% allowance. A small sublimation press turns the plain mug into a personalised one, which is the biggest 2026 pull in gifting.

skuLines.line: Baby & newborn gifting
skuLines.examples: newborn gift set (bib+booties+rattle), 'Welcome Baby' card & balloon, baby soft blanket gift pack, silver-plated coin/spoon, cradle-ceremony decor
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; Lohri (13 Jan) is a traditional first-child celebration in Punjabi households
skuLines.notes: Married staff families with babies are an explicitly present cohort here and there is nowhere else within 30-50 km to buy a baby gift. Anything textile touching a newborn should be a known brand with a fibre/AZO-free label — don't buy loose. Silver-plated items need anti-tarnish pouches in this humidity.

skuLines.line: New Year calendars, diaries and planners (incl. Nanakshahi/Sikh calendar)
skuLines.examples: wall calendar, table calendar, Nanakshahi/Gurpurab calendar, corporate diary, student planner
skuLines.seasonality: Dec-Jan only — dead weight by February
skuLines.notes: A Sikh calendar marking Gurpurabs and Nanakshahi dates is a near-certain seller at this location and a generic distributor will not offer one — source it from a Punjab publisher. Extremely date-perishable: anything unsold on 31 January is scrap, so buy conservatively and take the Trust's institutional indent first.

skuLines.line: Deodorant / perfume and grooming gift sets
skuLines.examples: Fogg/Wild Stone/Engage gift pack, Park Avenue grooming combo, perfume + deo combo box, talc gift set
skuLines.seasonality: Birthdays, farewell, Rakhi return-gifting; year-round
skuLines.notes: The standard 18-25 peer gift, and a modest, institution-appropriate one. Aerosol deodorants are flammable pressurised goods — declare them for road transport and keep them out of the candle/paper store. No alcohol-forward marketing on display at a Sikh institution; lead with the grooming-combo framing.

skuLines.line: Ready gift hampers — assembled festival and celebration hampers
skuLines.examples: assembled Diwali/Bandi Chhor hamper (dry fruit + chocolate + diya + candle), rakhi hamper, birthday hamper, welcome-baby hamper
skuLines.seasonality: Bandi Chhor/Diwali Oct-Nov, Rakhi Aug, weddings Nov-Feb
skuLines.notes: Assemble in-house from lines you already stock — that converts three low-margin FMCG items plus ₹40 of wrap into a single ₹999 ticket and lifts the blended margin. Keep the shortest-dated component's expiry as the hamper's date. This is also the Trust's own outbound-gifting supply, which is a bulk order you can win outright.

skuLines.line: Firecrackers / green crackers (evaluate, likely EXCLUDE)
skuLines.examples: green crackers (anar, chakri, sparklers) — only from a licensed dealer
skuLines.seasonality: Bandi Chhor Divas, 8 Nov 2026 — a 3-day window
skuLines.notes: RECOMMEND NOT STOCKING. Requires an Explosives Act 1884 / Explosives Rules 2008 licence (LE-5 or a temporary sale licence from the Deputy Commissioner), only green crackers are permitted and only in DC-designated areas and hours — a residential school township is very unlikely to be one. Add a 5,000-person campus with children's dormitories and a 30-50 km fire-service distance and the risk is indefensible for a seasonal margin. Divert the entire Diwali/Bandi Chhor spend into lighting, LED diyas and decor, which is where the 2026 market is moving anyway.

trends2026: Balloon mix has shifted from plain multicolour to pastel/macaron (kids, baby events) and chrome gold/silver/rose-gold (milestones, premium) — driven by Instagram/Reels aesthetics like 'balloon rings', 'organic garlands' and pastel balloon walls, and it carries higher ticket values than the value tier it replaced.

Ready-made all-in-one DIY decoration kits (30-75 pcs, ₹250-₹700) are the fastest-growing shape and are displacing loose components — one scan replaces a decorator, which is exactly right for a captive campus with no party shop nearby.

Theme-coordinated return gifts (unicorn, space, superhero) have replaced random loose toys; parents now buy a cohesive party package rather than giveaways, so tableware, kit and return gift must share a theme or none of them sell.

Personalisation is the dominant gifting trend — name-printed banners, photo/name cake toppers, engraved mementos, custom-name rakhi — and it is the single easiest service a small store can bolt on with a printer, a laminator and a mug press.

Sustainability moved from premium to baseline expectation: clay/terracotta diyas over plastic, kraft and jute gift bags, seed-paper and recycled cards, plastic-free wrap, and an active retreat from thermocol and PVC decor. This also matches how a Trust-run institution wants to be seen.

Green-cracker-only rules plus school and township restrictions have pushed Diwali/Bandi Chhor spend out of fireworks and into lighting and decor — LED diyas, string and curtain lights, kandeels, rangoli stickers are now where the festival money lands.

Cake culture has moved from bakery to household: sparkler and number candles, acrylic toppers, cake boards and boxes are now routine grocery-basket lines bought by anyone with a cake, not trade-only supplies.

Printed greeting cards keep shrinking globally (~US$23bn in 2020 to a projected US$20.9bn by 2026, roughly -1.7% CAGR) as e-cards take over — but the decline reverses in exactly this niche: residential schools where handwritten and handmade cards are a school activity, so the growth is in card-making inputs (glitter card, quilling, craft tools) more than in printed cards.
Self-assembled hampers: shoppers buy an empty box, pick their own fillers, add cellophane and ribbon — a build-your-own-hamper counter now beats pre-packed hampers on both margin and perceived value.

Experiential and hybrid gifting (a physical item plus an experience or a service) is taking budget share from pure-product gifting at the premium end, with Indian corporate gifting budgets moving 25-35% into experiences.
adjacentServices: Gift-wrapping counter — free above a basket threshold or ₹10-₹30 a parcel. The single biggest attach available: a captive campus with nowhere else to go, and it pulls wrap, ribbon, tags and cards into every gift purchase.

Balloon inflation and on-site decoration setup for hostel and staff-quarter birthdays — air-fill only (no helium cylinders on hill roads), charged ₹300-₹1,500 a setup. Turns a ₹359 kit into a ₹1,000+ ticket and is pure labour margin.

Cake pre-order desk tied to the canteens/bakery: cake + candles + topper + card + box as one day-ahead bundle. With ~14 birthdays a day across 5,000 residents this is a standing order book, not a promotion.

Birthday and anniversary reminder register (opt-in) using the school roll and staff records — a WhatsApp/SMS nudge two days ahead with a suggested bundle. Converts a predictable event into a booked sale instead of a missed one.

Build-your-own-hamper counter: empty box, pick fillers from ARY's own dry-fruit, chocolate and candle lines, wrap and cellophane, priced by contents. Lifts three low-margin FMCG items into one high-margin ticket.
Rakhi posting/courier desk through August — rakhi, box, envelope, address writing and postage in one stop for students sending home. Also works in reverse for parcels arriving for students.
Photo printing, mounting and framing — farewell, convocation, sports day, plus everyday passport photos. Pairs directly with the photo-frame and memento lines and has no competitor within 30-50 km.
Custom name banner, photo cake topper and personalised mug printing (small inkjet, laminator, sublimation press) — captures the strongest 2026 gifting trend with a sub-₹50,000 equipment spend.

Event-decor rental instead of sale for annual day, sports day and prize distribution — reusable cloth backdrops, drapes, string lights and stands hired to the school and university, which are already buying this from Chandigarh or Nahan.

Institutional indent desk for the Trust, school and university: national-day flags, medals, trophies, certificate folders, Gurpurab illumination supplies, langar disposables and outbound festival hampers, agreed against an annual activity calendar rather than ad-hoc.
Staff-wedding and cradle-ceremony decor package — labour plus rented decor, booked in the Nov-Feb wedding season, using stock already held for campus events.
Return-gift bulk pre-pack service for parents' visiting days — 10 or 20 coordinated bags assembled to a theme, ordered a week ahead.
